# Third-party dependencies

- Leaflet 1.9.4 — https://leafletjs.com — BSD-2-Clause, see LEAFLET-LICENSE.txt. Downloaded from the official npm package via unpkg.
- qrcode-generator 1.4.4 — Kazuhiko Arase — MIT, copyright and licence reference preserved at the top of qrcode.js. https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- Map tiles: https://tile.openstreetmap.org/ with visible OpenStreetMap attribution. Remote network dependency, not bundled or cached for offline use.
